name: instagram-agent
description: Thirteen Claude skills that run an Instagram account: Reels off 26 hook formulas with a scored hook and a timed beat sheet, a research skill that finds what is working in your niche and ranks it by outlier multiple, captions linted against the feed truncation, carousels, stories, profile score, weekly plan, comments, replies, DMs, repurposing, audits, and a humanizer that strips the AI fingerprint before anything ships. This fork adds Turkish (Türkçe) support: syllable-timed beat sheets, Turkish hook scoring, Turkish examples for all 26 formulas and a Turkish slop lexicon.
